summary: A vine makes a melee spell attack: 4d8 Bludgeoning, pulls the target 30 ft toward it and grabs it.
text: A vine sprouts from a surface in an unoccupied space you can see within range and lasts for the duration. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 feet of the vine. On a hit, the target takes 4d8 Bludgeoning damage and is pulled up to 30 feet toward the vine; if it is Huge or smaller, it also has the Grappled condition (escape DC equal to your spell save DC). The vine can grapple only one creature at a time, and you can release a creature it holds (no action required). On each of your later turns, you can take a Bonus Action to repeat the attack against a creature within 30 feet of the vine. Concentration, up to 1 minute. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the vine can grapple one more creature for each slot level above 4.
